The Lab/2013

Exun 2013

November 2013 · Design & development

Our Breaking Bad parody for a school design competition.

Dates & sources

The recovered folder identifies Exun 2013, and its HTML is dated 29 November 2013. The original page credits our team at Code Warriors.

I worked with Panini Pandey and Aditya Garg on a fictional brand inspired by Breaking Bad for Exun 2013. We made angular blue illustrations and wrote out the thinking behind the shapes and colors.

I’ve kept the original RV and palette graphics here, arranged together for this archive. The design was a competition parody.
